objectClass.primaryType: stylized chibi slime-humanoid game character (biped) with techwear outfit, goggles and backpack ink tank
objectClass.notes: Observed on reference/front.png plus observed side/back/3-4 views (turnaround sheet). Slime body + hair are glossy turquoise; outfit black/charcoal with turquoise piping and white tee; goggles white frame + black lens; backpack glass ink tank with hose to the right hip. Toon/semi-glossy illustration with ink outlines.

reasoning: Silhouette is heavily interrupted: ~16 blobby hair locks + crown tuft + droplets, goggles wider than the head, puffy sleeves, baggy cargo pants with pockets, chunky shoes, and a backpack tank with a hose loop.

Many visible sub-parts (goggle lens/frame/strap/clips, harness straps/buckles, tank glass/liquid/caps/bands/valve, hose, wristbands, cuffs, cargo pockets/flaps, shoe midsole/outsole/upper/tongue/laces).
Repeated systems: hair locks, hair drips, tank bands, lace bars, hose corrugation ribs.

Material layers: slime (glossy clearcoat), goggle lens (gloss black), white plastic frame, strap fabric, black nylon jacket, turquoise piping, white cotton tee, charcoal twill pants, rubber/synthetic shoe parts, glass tank, liquid, brushed metal, black rubber hose.
Occlusion risk is low because the sheet supplies front/3-4/side/back; only jacket interior, skull top under hair, sole underside are hidden.
Action readiness need is high: animation-ready game character (articulated limbs, hand_r blaster socket, back tank socket, detachable goggles/tank).

specDepthDecision.rationale: complex: articulated character with layered garments, worn hardware and repeated hair/drip/band systems; requires macro/meso/micro levels, repetition systems, local overrides and >=4 review views.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation: Skull top height under the hair mass (estimated y=55 px in front.png, confidence 0.5) -> head-unit value carries +-10% uncertainty.
Exact digit count: reads as 3 fingers + thumb (mitten slime hand); modelled as 4 digits.
Jacket interior and inner collar depth are hidden (only turquoise collar lining visible).
Outsole tread pattern underside is hidden; side lug rhythm only.
Hose routing behind the right hip between the tank bottom cap and the coil is partially occluded in back/side views.
Face under the goggle lens is not depicted (no eyes) -> no eye geometry is authored.
Hair lock count ~16 primary locks (+ crown tuft and top-right lock); individual lock paths beyond the observed silhouettes are inferred.
Left side is not directly observed (side view shows the character's right); left is mirrored except the hose (right only).

proportions.notes: torso = neck-base->hip-joint trunk segment in HU (the quantity new_sculpt_spec._hu_ratio consumes); crownToHip is the reconstruction.md definition. shoulderWidth = shoulder joint-to-joint (outer boxy jacket ~1.25 HU). hipWidth = 0.8 HU (pants outer at hip y=370 is 129px = 0.78 HU). Figure = 3.5 skull-HU incl. hair tuft, 2.85 HU if the hair mass is counted as head.

pose.type: A-pose; bind pose == reference pose (angles baked into attachment endpoints, jointAngles left at identity to avoid double application)
pose.stance: symmetric, weight centred, feet planted shoulder-width apart, toes slightly outward

faceLandmarks.notes: Normalized to the head box (skull top est. y=55 -> chin y=221). No eyes, nose or ears are depicted: eyeLine is the goggle-lens centre line (the lens occupies the eye region); eyeSpacing/noseBase/ear values are not applicable (null), not unmeasured. hairline = lower edge of the slime fringe where it meets the goggle frame.

anatomy.styleAxis: chibi/stylized (between chibi 2-3 HU and stylized 5-6 HU)
anatomy.measurementSource: reference/front.png 400x615, PIL row/column scans of the foreground mask (bg rgb 244,243,239); ground y=600, figure top (hair tuft) y=16
anatomy.landmarkTooling: extract_landmarks.py (stdlib overlay+scaffold) ran; MediaPipe face/pose landmarks are not applicable to an eyeless/noseless stylized slime face behind goggles, so values were measured manually from pixels.
anatomy.note: Measured from reference/front.png pixels (see pipeline/anatomy.json, pipeline/landmarks.png). extract_landmarks.py produced the overlay/scaffold; values filled manually because face landmark models do not apply to an eyeless slime face behind goggles.

definitionOfDone: Front render at the reference camera matches the chibi proportion lock: head+hair ~35% of figure height, goggles band at 63% of head height, fingertips at upper-thigh, crotch at ~36% of height from the ground.
Slime hair reads as blobby drooping teardrop locks with a rising crown tuft and falling droplets, never as a smooth helmet cap.
Goggles read as a single wide black glossy lens in a white rounded frame, wider than the head, with a black strap around the head and silver clips at the temples; small smile visible below.

Outfit palette reads turquoise-on-black: cropped boxy black jacket with turquoise piping and turquoise collar lining over a white tee, charcoal cargo joggers with turquoise outer-seam stripe, cargo pockets, gathered cuffs.
Backpack glass ink tank with turquoise liquid, black caps, silver bands, black harness straps with silver buckles, and a corrugated black hose looping to the right hip are visible from back/side/3-4.
Chunky sneakers with white midsole, turquoise outsole, black upper with turquoise panels and white laces.
Hierarchy is action-ready: articulated limbs/digits, hand_r blaster socket, back tank socket, detachable goggles/tank, colliders on macro parts.

featureGroups.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: Bounding shape, dominant curves, negative spaces, and scale relationships are explicitly described.
failureModes: model reads as a generic placeholder instead of the reference object
major proportions are guessed without evidence

featureGroups.name: Primary structure and hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Major parts, joints, seams, contact points, and parent-child relationships are named before code generation.
failureModes: large visible parts are merged into one mesh
component hierarchy is too shallow for the observed complexity

featureGroups.name: Attachment and joint correctness
qualityCriteria: Every visible child appendage, branch, limb, handle, connector, tube, cable, horn, wing, leg, or hinged part has an attachment contract with parent socket, localStart/localEnd, contact type, embed/overlap, and gap tolerance.
failureModes: child part root floats away from the parent
branch/limb/tube is centered in space instead of pivoting from its root
parent-child transform mixes world and local coordinates

featureGroups.name: Surface material response
qualityCriteria: Albedo zones, roughness, normal/bump/displacement intent, cavity dirt, edge wear, and local overrides are specified where visible.
Important materials define independent albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO responses instead of reusing one texture for unrelated PBR channels.
Surface response is decomposed into macro, meso, and micro frequency bands with scale and amplitude tied to object scale.
failureModes: surface looks like flat plastic
local material variation is missing or not tied to image evidence

featureGroups.name: Reference color, material, and lighting response
qualityCriteria: Material-pass names the reference-derived albedo palette, roughness variation, tactile normal/bump/displacement response, and local masks.
When a source image is available, run reference PBR extraction and require confidence >= 0.7 before treating maps as implementation-ready.
Lighting-pass names key/fill/rim or environment light, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadow behavior.
Neutral, grazing-angle, and reference-matched renders prove that surface relief survives relighting and is not painted into albedo.
failureModes: model has acceptable shape but reads as flat shaded or plastic
colors are a generic average instead of reference-observed local color zones
lighting is evenly ambient and cannot reproduce the source value range

featureGroups.name: Slime hair drip silhouette
qualityCriteria: ~16 tapered-sweep locks with bulbous rounded tips droop around the skull; fringe locks end at the goggle top; side locks reach cheek level; crown tuft rises then curls toward +X; 4-6 droplets fall beside the head.
failureModes: hair reads as a smooth cap/helmet
locks are straight noodles without bulbous tips
hair sinks into the skull (bald patch)

featureGroups.name: Goggles: white frame + single black lens + strap
qualityCriteria: Lens spans 0.44-0.86 of head height and is wider than the head (1.17x), frame white with rounded corners, strap black around the head over the hair, silver clips at temples.
failureModes: two separate eye lenses
goggles narrower than the head
strap missing at back

featureGroups.name: Turquoise-on-black outfit palette + piping
qualityCriteria: Jacket black with turquoise piping on front panels/sleeves and turquoise collar lining; pants charcoal with turquoise outer-seam stripe; white tee visible at front opening and below jacket hem.
failureModes: piping/stripes missing
jacket not cropped (covers hips)
tee not visible

featureGroups.name: Backpack ink tank + harness + hose
qualityCriteria: Vertical glass cylinder with turquoise liquid, black top/bottom caps, silver bands, on a black back plate; harness straps + buckles on the chest; corrugated hose loops from the bottom cap to the right hip.
failureModes: tank opaque/flat colour without glass read
hose on the wrong side
tank floating off the back

featureGroups.name: Chunky sneakers
qualityCriteria: Shoe length ~0.39 world units (~1 HU), thick white midsole, turquoise outsole rim, black upper with turquoise panels, white laces, toe-out ~12 deg.
failureModes: shoes read as small flat boxes
midsole/outsole colour bands missing

visualDeltaChecks: local feature placement and scale delta
goggle band height and width vs head
hair lock count and tip bulbousness
tank/hose placement in back and side views
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

authoringInstruction: Fill observed object class, complexity reasoning, featureGroups, visualDeltaChecks, and unknowns before generating or implementing ObjectSculptSpec.
